title: Smart Budgets Launch Readiness Meeting
summary: The team reviewed the final launch checklist for Smart Budgets, confirming that support training, status page, deduplication fix, and categorizer accuracy are all on track. Risks around Plaid rate‑limits were mitigated with an exponential backoff queue and real‑time alerts. Monitoring plans, UI finalization, and communication steps were finalized, and a decision was made to launch on Wednesday, October 29 at 9 am Pacific. All owners confirmed their responsibilities and the launch is set for a smooth rollout.
key_points: Support team training completed and status page ready for launch
Deduplication fix processed 41,000 transactions with zero duplicates observed
Plaid integration risk addressed with exponential backoff queue; alerts added to status page
Monitoring plan includes alerts, 48‑hour dashboard watch, and handoff to ops on day three
UI assets and minor copy changes are on schedule for launch
Launch announcement will be posted on Oct 29; all teams clear for the launch

decisions.decision: Launch Smart Budgets on Wednesday, October 29 at 9 am Pacific
Push notifications will be deferred until November

action_items.task: Prepare final assets for the launch splash
Add a queue with exponential backoff for Plaid calls
Set up alerts on categorization error dashboards and monitor for the first 48 hours post-launch
Ensure email-only weekly summary template is locked and scheduler set to start on launch day
Push minor copy changes on the “Set Your Goal” screen
Transition monitoring dashboards to ops on day three and stay on call for the first 24 hours
Post launch announcement in the company all-hands channel on October 29
Watch categorization error dashboards for the first 48 hours
